report: 图像中存在明显的JPEG压缩块状效应，但这一现象并不足以单独作为判定图像真实性的依据。由于没有其他有效的工具或证据可以提供额外的信息来降低不确定性，因此无法进一步降低图像的真实性判断的不确定性。

evidence.phenomenon: JPEG structural analysis reveals DCT coefficient histogram hollowing. (blockiness: 0.8779, DCT anomaly: 4.6279)
evidence.reasoning: Moderate JPEG structure found (blockiness=0.8779, DCT anomaly=4.6279). This is the weaker end of the calibration band: the same structure appears when an already-compressed image is re-saved, and at low quality (≤ 70) the band loses its discriminative power almost entirely, so it should not drive a verdict on its own. Whether the band is decisive here depends on the cell the calibration table records for this input, which is attached to the token.
evidence.interpretation_text: Calibration: this measurement band corresponds to camera-source statistics (P(Fake)=0.39); the benign reading applies.
evidence.counter_explanation: 本指标衡量"是否存在 JPEG 压缩历史"而非伪造痕迹：G2 校准显示高值倾向 Real（PNG 格分离度 0.972、native 0.962，但重压缩至 q70 后降至 0.569），即它主要反映来源的压缩历史。统一重压缩后的图像上该证据近乎无效，不得作为独立判据。
evidence.applicability_conditions: 高 strength 统计上对应 Real（原生 JPEG 照片）；q70 配平后分离度仅 0.57。仅当来源无压缩历史时可反向参考。
evidence.interpretation_text_raw: Intermediate JPEG structural level; this band is near the calibrated chance level, and re-compression weakens it further.
